routing._comment_thresholds: score >= regex_threshold → regex; score >= hybrid_threshold → hybrid; else → llm. prefer_deterministic promotes ties at threshold boundaries to the cheaper route.

cost_model._comment_cost: Assumes claude-haiku-4-5 at ~100 input tokens + ~50 output tokens per parse call. Rate: $0.80/M input, $4.00/M output → ~$0.00008 per call.
cost_model._comment_regex_cost: CPU cost only; negligible at scale. Included for completeness in ROI calculations.

volume._comment_volume: Total parsing operations per day across all 8 task types combined, based on p50 production traffic.

hybrid_policy._comment_promote: If fallthrough rate drops below 10% over 7 days, promote hybrid to full regex.
hybrid_policy._comment_demote: If fallthrough rate exceeds 60% over 7 days, demote hybrid to full LLM and re-score.
hybrid_policy._comment_min_samples: Do not act on promote/demote signals until at least 200 parse calls have been observed.

monitoring._comment_failure_alert: Trigger re-score review if parse failure rate exceeds 2% over a 7-day rolling window.
monitoring._comment_review: Scheduled quarterly re-score for all hybrid and regex tasks regardless of alert status.
